image.subject: lotus meditation symbol
details: Small golden orb accent above the central petal
Soft navy blue petals with subtle inner glow
Generous padding around the icon (safe area for 16x16)
Crisp clean edges optimized for small sizes
No text, no watermark, no border, no background frame
constraints: Do not add any text or letterforms
Do not add any extra icons, decorations, or shadows beyond subtle inner glow
Preserve symmetry around the vertical axis
Safe area: keep at least 10% padding on all sides
Output must look readable at 16x16 and 32x32

prompts.en: Minimalist lotus meditation symbol, centered, with a small golden orb accent above the central petal, symmetrical, soft navy blue petals with subtle inner glow, generous padding around the icon, transparent background, crisp edges optimized for small sizes (16x16 and 32x32), no text, no border, high contrast on both light and dark browser tabs.
prompts.pt_br: Símbolo minimalista de lótus meditativo, centralizado, com um pequeno orbe dourado acima da pétala central, simétrico, pétalas em azul-marinho suave com leve brilho interno, bastante espaço de respiro ao redor do ícone, fundo transparente, bordas nítidas otimizadas para tamanhos pequenos (16x16 e 32x32), sem texto, sem borda, alto contraste em abas claras e escuras.
